title: Platform detection
description: Auto-detect the target platform (web-electron-ts vs other) from project files, scaffold-design.md, or human input before any UI design steps run.

title: Layout capture via Figma reference
description: Read a Figma file or node via get_metadata and get_screenshot to capture structural layout and visual reference for component mapping.

title: ReUI component mapping
description: Map each layout section to a free-tier ReUI component via the ReUI MCP search tool; flag unmatched sections as gaps without silent substitution.

title: Design doc and roadmap output
description: Write design.md, design.html companion, roadmap.json entries, and ROADMAP.html after approval; hand off to writing-plans as the terminal state.
